experiment: Scene-generation audit + solvability guarantee + difficulty tuning (3v1 contract-v2)

audit.legacy_sampling: 4 corner-diagonal families; evader spawn near one corner, private goal near the opposite corner (route >= 4.0 m); 3 pursuers placed route-relative ahead of the evader (interceptor 1.30-1.50 m forward +-0.08 lateral; flanks 0.85-0.95 forward, +-0.65-0.75 lateral), then shuffled; procedural obstacles 1-4 avoiding spawns/goal/route. Rejections are geometric sanity only: outside arena, pursuer distance outside 0.90-1.60 m band, pairwise spawn separation < 0.55 m, evader initially enclosed, obstacles block the EVADER route. There is NO capturability check: a scene is emitted whenever it is geometrically clean.
solvable_risk_sources: goal corridor obstacle layouts that also slow pursuer approach
marginal spawn geometries near the distance-band edge
config: evader faster (0.50 vs 0.45) and private goal -> any spawn where the trio is NOT between evader and goal is essentially unwinnable for nominal speeds
audit.capability_note: capture happens ~2 s at the spawn arc, before obstacles/routes further down-range matter, so arc-shape/route/obstacle knobs barely move the teacher.

machinery.SceneSamplingOptions: runtime-only knob dataclass (NOT in TaskConfig -> task fingerprint unchanged, no checkpoint/dataset invalidation). Legacy default reproduces old sampling exactly (options=None).
machinery.analytic_solvability: opt-in fast open-field prefilter: requires some route point where all 3 pursuers reach an enclosing ring no later than the evader's straight-line arrival + hold + slack. Conservative (straight-running evader); validated: 0 leaks/0 over-rejection on legacy (250 scenes); over-rejects very wide/far spawns (evader drag dynamics give real capture more time than the bound assumes) - use it for legacy-like families, use the oracle authority below for far families.
machinery.oracle_solvability_authority: scan_scene_solvability.py runs teacher under speed boosts on each sampled scene; a scene is oracle-solvable if captured at 1.5x pursuer speed. Per-preset unsolvable_estimate = 1 - oracle_x1.5 rate.

far1_spawn_1.3-2.1m.note: SELECTED hard mode: expert in target band, 100% oracle-solvable

geometry_only_presets.conclusion: arc spread / short route / corridor obstacles do NOT dent the teacher (0.94-1.0): capture at the spawn arc precedes their effect

difficulty_ladder_250scenes_clean.hard_gap: analytic mode rejected all (arc too open by the conservative bound); geometry check also rejects spawns beyond the 0.90-1.60 band unless the band override is raised

conclusion.what_moves_difficulty: evader-to-pursuer spawn distance band (steep curve: 0.93 @ 0.9-1.6 m -> 0.80 @ 1.3-2.1 m -> 0.08 @ 1.7-2.8 m) and capture radius (physics knob); geometry-only knobs are ineffective because capture is decided in the first ~2 s at the spawn arc.
conclusion.selected_hard_mode: preset 'hard' (= far1): template interceptor 1.60-1.85 ahead, flanks 1.10-1.35 forward / 1.10-1.40 lateral, accepted spawn band 1.30-2.10 m. Teacher 0.796 (clean), oracle-1.5 1.000 -> every emitted scene capturable-by-construction under the oracle authority; 20pp headroom for better-than-expert policies.
conclusion.solvability_guarantee: generation keeps geometric sanity checks and, when requested, the analytic prefilter; authoritative guarantee is the boosted-oracle validation (scan_scene_solvability.py), per-preset unsolvable_estimate. Legacy 0.4%, hard/far1 0.0% over 250 scenes.
conclusion.backward_compat: TaskConfig untouched -> existing checkpoints/expert datasets/task fingerprints unaffected; new scene modes only active when the generator is constructed with SceneSamplingOptions (e.g. preset 'hard'), default stays legacy.
